skills.purpose: Map loose request wording to a validated prompt template and normalized intent contract.
invariants: Preserve user intent.
Do not introduce new task objectives.
failure_conditions: No template match and no fallback prompt.
skills.purpose_long: Map loose request wording to a validated prompt template and normalized intent contract.

skills.purpose: Compile a freeform user request into a structured AgentizedTaskPacket with classification, execution mode, targeted context, standards, verification, and output contract.
invariants: Preserve the original user intent.
Use prompt-library entries only as supporting evidence, not a mandatory static mapping.
Context plans must be targeted and explain why each source is needed.
Every packet must include verification and handoff requirements.
failure_conditions: Empty request.
Packet omits execution-mode reasoning.
Packet requires full-repo context without a concrete reason.
side_effects: May record agentize outcome evaluations when a run completes.
skills.purpose_long: Compile a freeform user request into a structured AgentizedTaskPacket with classification, execution mode, targeted context, standards, verification, and output contract.

skills.purpose: Extract and maintain canonical project operating language: domain terms, architecture terms, and agent-control leading words for prompts, specs, code review, tests, docs, and workflow gates.
invariants: Use the smallest sufficient authoritative project context.
Every agent-control leading word must have a trigger and completion criterion.
Rejected synonyms must point to a preferred canonical term.
Do not keep generic quality words unless they have observable project-specific behavior.
failure_conditions: No authoritative project sources are available.
Agent-control terms lack observable completion criteria.
The output creates overlapping canonical terms without resolving aliases.
side_effects: May propose migrations for prompts, docs, tests, issues, or review gates.
skills.purpose_long: Extract and maintain canonical project operating language: domain terms, architecture terms, and agent-control leading words for prompts, specs, code review, tests, docs, and workflow gates.

skills.purpose: Retrieve bounded style profile context from the personal corpus for writing tasks.
invariants: Retrieve bounded excerpts only.
Do not dump full notes into prompts.
failure_conditions: Vault unavailable and no fallback style profile.
skills.purpose_long: Retrieve bounded style profile context from the personal corpus for writing tasks.

skills.purpose: Generate structured draft sections from normalized objective and context profile.
invariants: Preserve argument intent and section structure.
failure_conditions: Missing sectioned draft output.
skills.purpose_long: Generate structured draft sections from normalized objective and context profile.

skills.purpose: Improve prose rhythm/readability while preserving factual meaning, citations, and specificity.
invariants: Must preserve factual meaning.
Must preserve argument structure.
Must preserve citation references.
failure_conditions: Meaning drift beyond configured threshold.
skills.purpose_long: Improve prose rhythm/readability while preserving factual meaning, citations, and specificity.

skills.purpose: Verify required paper structure is present.
invariants: Validation output must be explicit pass/fail.
failure_conditions: Missing required section headings.
skills.purpose_long: Verify required paper structure is present.

skills.purpose: Verify citation coverage is present and non-empty.
invariants: No fake citation claims when no citation marker exists.
failure_conditions: No citation markers in output.
skills.purpose_long: Verify citation coverage is present and non-empty.

skills.purpose: Check transformed prose for major keyword/intent drift from draft.
invariants: Meaning-preservation evaluation must be reproducible.
failure_conditions: Keyword overlap below threshold.
skills.purpose_long: Check transformed prose for major keyword/intent drift from draft.

skills.purpose: Ensure output remains scoped to objective and contract.
invariants: Detect obvious out-of-scope expansion.
failure_conditions: Output does not reference objective terms.
skills.purpose_long: Ensure output remains scoped to objective and contract.

skills.purpose: Classify whether a task benefits from divergent strategy exploration and select a mode.
invariants: Simple deterministic tasks should not be escalated to broad exploration.
Mode selection must be explainable.
failure_conditions: No classification reason is available.
skills.purpose_long: Classify whether a task benefits from divergent strategy exploration and select a mode.

skills.purpose: Generate role-based candidate strategies from the divergent candidate registry.
invariants: Candidates must include risks and why they might fail.
Candidates must represent distinct strategic angles.
failure_conditions: All candidates converge to the same formulation.
skills.purpose_long: Generate role-based candidate strategies from the divergent candidate registry.

skills.purpose: Evaluate divergent candidates through reusable judge profiles with structured rationale.
invariants: Every judgment must include a score, verdict, critique, and recommended action.
Judge results are evidence, not ground truth.
failure_conditions: A judge emits a score without rationale.
skills.purpose_long: Evaluate divergent candidates through reusable judge profiles with structured rationale.

skills.purpose: Select a portfolio of useful candidates instead of collapsing to one winner.
invariants: Portfolio must include best overall, safest implementation, highest upside, and useful failure slots.
failure_conditions: Workflow completes without portfolio output.
skills.purpose_long: Select a portfolio of useful candidates instead of collapsing to one winner.

skills.purpose: Create approval-gated HOW, WHAT, FAILURE, and ENTROPY memory proposals.
invariants: Do not silently mutate global memory.
Writeback proposals must include rationale and evidence.
failure_conditions: Memory is promoted without approval evidence.
skills.purpose_long: Create approval-gated HOW, WHAT, FAILURE, and ENTROPY memory proposals.

invariants: Mode selection must be explainable.
Creative and professional contexts must remain separated unless explicitly allowed.
failure_conditions: Unknown requested mode.
skills.purpose_long: Classify writing tasks into personalized voice modes before corpus retrieval or rewriting.

skills.purpose: Retrieve bounded, mode-compatible personal voice references for the personalized humanizer.
invariants: Prefer approved user-written examples.
Do not store sensitive excerpt text by default.
Do not use creative corpus for professional outreach unless explicitly allowed.
failure_conditions: Retrieved examples violate mode boundaries.
skills.purpose_long: Retrieve bounded, mode-compatible personal voice references for the personalized humanizer.

skills.purpose: Build a compact task-specific voice packet from the versioned personal voice profile and evidence refs.
invariants: Voice packet must include style rules, anti-style rules, confidence, and provenance.
Voice packet must be compact enough for agent use.
failure_conditions: Requested mode is missing from the profile.
skills.purpose_long: Build a compact task-specific voice packet from the versioned personal voice profile and evidence refs.

skills.purpose: Rewrite text toward the selected personal voice mode while preserving meaning, structure, and factual claims.
invariants: Preserve factual meaning and original intent.
Do not add unsupported personal details.
Do not over-humanize technical prompts.
When running after the generic humanizer, limit the pass to personal voice adaptation.
failure_conditions: Meaning drift or unsupported claim introduction.
skills.purpose_long: Rewrite text toward the selected personal voice mode while preserving meaning, structure, and factual claims.

skills.purpose: Score personalized humanizer output for meaning preservation, voice match, context fit, specificity, and risk.
invariants: Quality checks must include hallucination and over-personalization risk.
Debug output must explain selected profile and applied rules.
failure_conditions: Scorecard is missing required dimensions.
skills.purpose_long: Score personalized humanizer output for meaning preservation, voice match, context fit, specificity, and risk.

skills.purpose: Record approved, edited, or rejected outputs as evidence for candidate profile updates.
invariants: Do not silently mutate canonical voice profiles.
Profile update proposals require evidence before approval.
failure_conditions: Feedback directly changes active profile rules.
side_effects: Writes feedback and candidate profile update records.
skills.purpose_long: Record approved, edited, or rejected outputs as evidence for candidate profile updates.

skills.purpose: Design engineering principles for making interfaces feel polished. Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code, implementing animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any visual detail work.
invariants: Apply UI polish principles without overriding project-specific design systems or accessibility requirements.
Review output should use grouped markdown tables with Before and After columns when changes are made.
failure_conditions: Polish guidance contradicts explicit project UI standards.
Review output omits concrete before/after evidence for changed UI details.
skills.purpose_long: Design engineering principles for making interfaces feel polished. Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code, implementing animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any visual detail work.

skills.purpose: Operate the mature-repo behavioral spec verification loop with single-writer spreadsheet discipline, test/fix/re-test iterations, regression coverage, and complexity review.
skills.purpose_long: Use this only inside the behavioral-spec-verification-loop workflow. It coordinates code-derived cataloging, canonical spreadsheet updates, evidence-backed testing, defect remediation, re-testing, regression coverage, and boundary audit without making the heavy loop a default path.
invariants: Use exactly one canonical .xlsx artifact as the source of truth.
Keep the main thread as the single spreadsheet writer.
Derive expected behavior from source citations rather than guesses.
Do not mark rows Verified without command/action evidence and last tested commit.
Do not mark rows Regression-Covered without automated coverage or a documented infeasibility note.
Run thermo-nuclear-simplification as the complexity gate for fixes.
failure_conditions: Maturity gate is not eligible and no explicit override is present.
Canonical spreadsheet is missing, forked, or mutated by multiple writers.
Verified or Regression-Covered status is unsupported by evidence.
A fix exceeds the three-iteration safety cap for a story.
side_effects: Writes one canonical behavioral-spec.xlsx artifact under the run planning directory.
May write tests and scoped fixes for defects logged in the spreadsheet.

skills.purpose: Audit setup, local commands, validation loops, docs, CI, and developer workflow friction using the Developer Experience capability pack.
invariants: Load minimum sufficient context.
Mark unavailable metrics as not_measured.
failure_conditions: Findings lack repo-local evidence.
Metrics blend measured and inferred values.

skills.purpose: Review public APIs, SDKs, CLIs, config schemas, examples, errors, and migration paths from the developer-consumer perspective.
invariants: Cite public entrypoints, docs, tests, examples, or errors.
Do not invent consumer expectations.
failure_conditions: Findings are not tied to a public developer-facing surface.

skills.purpose: Create or revise developer-first documentation with working commands, limitations, and validation evidence.
invariants: Do not document speculative behavior as shipped.
Avoid marketing or placeholder prose.
failure_conditions: Docs describe behavior not backed by source or commands.
side_effects: May write scoped documentation changes in implementation mode.

skills.purpose: Perform contextual DX security review for permissions, secrets, auth, dependencies, tools, CI, logs, privacy, and network or filesystem risk.
invariants: Findings must be contextual and evidence-backed.
Generic checklist dumping is not acceptable final output.
failure_conditions: Findings lack exact files, config keys, commands, or data flows.

skills.purpose: Review TypeScript strictness, inference, public types, package boundaries, and typecheck/build performance only when TypeScript risk justifies it.
invariants: Invoke only for TypeScript-heavy or public type surfaces.
Cite type errors, type declarations, package config, or build output.
failure_conditions: Simple non-TypeScript-heavy changes trigger specialist routing.
side_effects: May write focused TypeScript changes in implementation mode.

skills.purpose: Implement from PRDs, ADRs, design specs, issues, or acceptance criteria with traceable requirements, assumptions, and verification.
invariants: Log low-risk assumptions.
Stop for destructive, security-sensitive, data-loss, or broad architecture decisions.
failure_conditions: Spec is missing or conflicting and no safe bounded assumption exists.
side_effects: May write scoped implementation changes in implementation mode.
